name: Gemac Engineering Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Gemac Engineering Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, sale, and maintenance of rail engineering equipment in China. The company offers heavy rail vehicles, electric construction, railway maintenance, rail transit vehicles, and freight equipment products. It also exports its products to more than 20 countries, such as Singapore, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Sri Lanka, India, Pakistan, Angola, Sierra Leone, Nigeria, Algeria, Tanzania, Sudan, north of New Zealand, Brazil, Laos, the United States, Taiwan, and Hongkong. The company was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Xiangyang, China.
